tokens.name: layout.primary
tokens.role: Single mobile reading spine with bounded sheets and bars. Primary actions remain reachable, legible, and physically credible on a handheld screen.

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts or exact type values are stored.
tokens.role: Neutral sans type separates task labels, reading text, and compact values. Bars, sheets, tabs, and transitions preserve location without imitating a desktop window model.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: The role is analytical; preview colors are original study values.
tokens.role: System controls support the current task while content keeps visual priority.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.role: Touch, keyboard, pointer, orientation, text size, and assistive technology can change without breaking the task.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Handheld task view with clear navigation, one reachable action, and adaptive text. Product, photography, illustration, and data each receive a separate job.
